column1: # comment: "Notation and symbolic system alignments \u2014 SKOS, schema.org, Wikidata. gmeow:SymbolicSystem and gmeow:NotationSystem are registry-independent, first-class information objects. No maintained external vocabulary covers them faithfully; the mappings here are broad-brush discovery links. Domain-specific notations (mathematical, musical, cryptographic) are aligned to Wikidata items by reference. The reified gmeow:NotationSystemUsage relator is canonical \u2014 no 1:1 SSSOM claim exists for it."

column6: Wikidata 'notation' (Q2001982) — a system of symbols to represent facts or quantities; a close related match.
schema.org DefinedTermSet is a set of defined terms — broader and flatter than SymbolicSystem, but the closest surface concept.
Wikidata 'symbol' (Q80071) — the general concept of a symbol, not a specific system; related match only.
Cryptography (Wikidata Q8789) — broader than notation, but the closest match.
